name: chessweeper
description: Chess meets Minesweeper: hidden mines, public numbers, private flags, kings with 3 lives.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.play: env -u VITE_SERVER_URL pnpm --filter @chessweeper/web build && pnpm --filter @chessweeper/server build && pnpm --filter @chessweeper/server exec tsx scripts/play.ts
